teaser.text: Meituan is an app-based marketplace and local-services operator: it helps people buy food, goods and services from nearby businesses, and it sometimes supplies the delivery or the goods itself. Its business becomes clear when you follow a customer’s payment to a merchant, rider, supplier or Meituan’s own costs—and then ask what remains.

stock.opening: The weighted forecast for Meituan is 106.34 HKD by October 2029, a 41% return including dividends. Meituan’s outcome hinges on operating recovery and cash generation proving durable.
stock.closing: The full Meituan memo also explains its business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could Meituan’s shares be by October 2029?

paragraphs.text: The weighted forecast rises from today’s 75.25 HKD, but the outcome depends heavily on operating recovery. At October 2027, the weighted price is 86.09 HKD, a 14% return including dividends. At October 2028, it reaches 95.69 HKD, a 27% return. At October 2029, it reaches 106.34 HKD, a 41% return.

blocks.heading: What has to go right for Meituan, and what could go wrong?

paragraphs.text: The evidence supports recovery but not a smooth return to former profitability. Core Local Commerce earned RMB5.67bn at a 7.9% margin in Q2 2026, while the 2024 margin was 20.9%. The bear case gives RMB2,000m of EBIT: RMB300bn of core revenue at a 7% margin, continued New Initiatives losses and RMB9bn of unallocated costs. The bull case gives RMB58,000m, based on RMB360bn of revenue, a 19% core margin and New Initiatives losses narrowing to RMB2.4bn. The bull requires competition to ease and newer businesses to approach break-even; management’s loss ceiling does not establish that outcome.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Meituan really make?

paragraphs.text: The core earnings turn is stark: operating margin moved from 10.9% in 2024 to -6.9% in 2025. The company’s real free cash flow, computed from cash from operations minus capital spending, fell to -10.3% of revenue in 2025 from 10.4% in 2024.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay today for Meituan?

paragraphs.text: Cash is the harder test. Meituan’s free-cash-flow yields are negative despite the positive earnings forecast. Inventory purchases, lending growth and working-capital movements can absorb cash, while merchant balances and customer advances may provide temporary funding. Cash awaiting payment to a restaurant also carries an obligation, so operating cash flow must be reconciled with the balance sheet.

earnings.title: Meituan earnings date and guidance
earnings.meta_description: Meituan's next results are expected on November 27, 2026; guidance covers the New Initiatives loss ceiling and positive delivery unit economics.
earnings.opening: Meituan's next results are expected on November 27, 2026. Watch whether delivery remains profitable through summer costs while expansion stays within management's loss ceiling.
earnings.closing: The full memo also explains Meituan's business, its rivals, its management and its risks.

paragraphs.text: New Initiatives is a reporting bucket, not a separate company. It includes businesses such as Keeta overseas delivery and grocery, while Core Local Commerce contains Meituan’s established operations. New Initiatives lost RMB10.082 billion in 2025, and management says its loss in 2026 should not exceed that level.

For delivery, management expects unit economics to remain positive in Q3, although weaker than in Q2. Unit economics measures whether one order covers the costs directly caused by serving it. If Meituan keeps RMB8 from an order and spends RMB7 on the courier and other order-specific costs, that order contributes RMB1. The contribution may still be too small to pay for engineers, offices and expansion.

blocks.heading: Did Meituan keep its promise on Select?

paragraphs.text: There is evidence of progress, but not a clean Select scorecard. Management promised in March 2024 to reduce Meituan Select’s operating loss; the broader New Initiatives loss fell from RMB20.2 billion in 2023 to RMB7.3 billion in 2024. That basket included several businesses, so the improvement cannot prove what happened at Select alone. Wang later called Select a strategic mistake after its effective wind-down.

blocks.heading: What do Meituan's last eight reported periods show?

paragraphs.text: The eight-quarter sequence gives the result its proper scale. Revenue growth first slowed sharply, then recovered, while operating losses narrowed before the June profit. The latest gross margin nevertheless remained below the level reached in September 2024.
